- Note 16 covers Disclosure Entity.
- The Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) is a NASA-owned facility which serves as a Federally Funded Research and Development Center (FFRDC).
- The facility commenced activities in the mid-1930s and at that time was sponsored by the U.S. Army to develop rocket technology and missile systems.
- The California Institute of Technology (Caltech), a private, not-for-profit 501(c)(3) university, manages JPL pursuant.
